title: Center view button pans the viewport back and forth
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 
v4.7.beta4.official [dff2b9bb6]
v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta4 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The 2d viewport pans back and forth by a small amount (maybe 1px), when continuing to click on the viewport's top left button: Center view
If it pans at all and the direction it pans, seem to depend on the viewport size.

### Steps to reproduce

- create a new empty project
- switch to the 2d workspace
- in the top left corner of the viewport
- keep clicking on the center view button

### Issue

If it only centers the view once then does nothing, change the viewport size by dragging the divider between the left sidebar and the viewport, and/or open the bottom output panel and drag the divider between the viewport and the output panel.

Maybe it's a viewport size rounding error, because the issue occurs on every other viewport width or height.

The screen recording shows Godot maximized on a 1080p display.
Clicking the center view button pans the viewport up and down.
The output panel is opened, the center view button centers the view in the new viewport size, and the center view button still pans the viewport up and down.
The viewport height is increased by 1px, by dragging the divider between the viewport and the output panel. Now the center view button doesn't pan up and down, nothing happens on the second or following presses.
The viewport height is increased by 1px again, the issue returned, the viewport pans up and down.
The viewport width is increased by 1px, by dragging the divider between the left sidebar and the viewport. Now the center view button pans the viewport both up and down and left and right.
The viewport width is increased by 1px, now the center view button only pans up and down. 
The viewport height is increased by 1px, the issue stopped, and the center view button doesn't pan the viewport.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db573c42-923c-48cd-83a3-36269b84a218

### Expected
Only center the viewport once on the first center view button click. Don't pan the viewport back and forth.
